properties.notes: Mixed site of both greenfield and brownfield land at edge of settlement. Small element is part of car sales business with remainder agricultural land. An extant outline permission is place for 60 units, and whilst yet to commence, delivery is forecast for the next 5 years (13/03894/OUT). A reserved matters application is now pending consideration (18/00751/REM). Brownfield element (0.27 ha) - indicative yield of around 8 dwellings can be calculated based on methodological approach. For indicative purposes in the BF Register, the original SHLAA site (ref 0429) is split to reflect brownfield and greenfield elements - total area of 3.26 ha.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
